# Highergov

HigherGov is a market intelligence platform providing comprehensive data on U.S. federal, state, and local government contracts and grants.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/highergov/.

## Actions

- **Get Agencies** (read-only): Retrieve agencies information.
- **Get Award History** (read-only): Retrieve award history.
- **Get Contract History** (read-only): Retrieve contract history.
- **Get Contract IDVs** (read-only): Retrieve Indefinite Delivery Vehicle (IDV) contract records via the HigherGov Contracts endpoint.
- **Get Contract Vehicles** (read-only): Retrieve contract vehicles.
- **Get Contracts** (read-only): Retrieve federal contract data.
- **Get Defense Programs** (read-only): Retrieve defense programs information.
- **Get DLA Contract Opportunities** (read-only): Retrieve DLA contract opportunities.
- **Get Documents** (read-only): Fetch document metadata from HigherGov.
- **Get Grant History** (read-only): Fetch historical data on grants.
- **Get Grant Opportunities** (read-only): Retrieve information on grant opportunities.
- **Get Grant Programs** (read-only): Retrieve information on grant programs.
- **Get NAICS Codes** (read-only): Retrieve NAICS codes.
- **Get Opportunities** (read-only): Retrieve opportunity data.
- **Get Opportunity History** (read-only): Retrieve opportunity history.
- **Get People** (read-only): Retrieve information on people related to government contracts and grants.
- **Get Prime Contract Awards** (read-only): Retrieve prime contract awards.
- **Get Prime Grant Awards** (read-only): Retrieve information on prime grant awards.
- **Get Product and Service Codes** (read-only): Retrieve information on Product and Service Codes.
- **Get Programs** (read-only): Retrieve a list of government programs and categories.
- **Get Pursuits** (read-only): Retrieve user-specific pursuits.
- **Get SBIR Opportunities** (read-only): Retrieve SBIR (Small Business Innovation Research) opportunities.
- **Get SLED Contract Opportunities** (read-only): Retrieve state and local (SLED) contract opportunities.
- **Get Subgrant Awards** (read-only): Retrieve subgrant awards information.
- **Get Task Orders** (read-only): Retrieve task order data.
- **Get Tech Programs** (read-only): Retrieve information on technology programs.
- **Get Subcontract Awards**: Retrieve subcontract awards.
